adopt: Describe one capability in one file and get the same name, arguments and JSON back from CLI, Python, MCP and relay.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
A tool that ships a CLI, a Python API and an MCP server ends up with three names, three argument shapes and three result formats, and nothing tells you which of them still work.

Install
not yet published; builds in-tree

Commands
  awcap
synopsis: Describe a capability once; call it the same way from CLI, Python, MCP and relay.
